usageNotes: Stops a running task on a PBS remote by sending a stop/cancel signal for the given UPID. The caller must hold Resource.Manage on the target remote; the UPID must belong to a task that is still active on the remote — attempting to stop an already-finished task is a no-op or may return an error depending on PBS version. Returns null on success; confirm the task has halted by polling the corresponding task-status endpoint.

examples.summary: Stop a running garbage-collection task on the 'prod-backup' PBS remote

destructiveReason: Terminates a running PBS task on the remote; any work performed by that task up to the point of cancellation may be incomplete or left in a partial state (e.g., a garbage-collection or prune run that did not finish).
tips: Retrieve the UPID from the task-list or task-log endpoints before calling this — UPIDs are opaque strings at least 42 characters long.
Only tasks in a running or queued state can be meaningfully stopped; finished tasks return null without error in most PBS versions.
After stopping, verify final task status via the corresponding GET task-status endpoint before assuming the operation fully rolled back.
